scripts.build: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/api && npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @privacy-round-trip/api" "npm run dev -w @privacy-round-trip/web"
scripts.test: npm run test:doctor && npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:contracts: forge test --root contracts/evm && scarb --manifest-path contracts/starknet/Scarb.toml build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @privacy-round-trip/shared && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/api && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/web && npm run typecheck -w @privacy-round-trip/canary
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format:contracts: forge fmt --root contracts/evm && scarb --manifest-path contracts/starknet/Scarb.toml fmt
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:contracts
